name: DS Cluster D19: Short Volume Units (0-100 not 0-1)
description: Tests: short_volume_ratio range is 0-100 (percentage), not 0-1 (decimal). Common agent mistake.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D19: Short Volume Units
# =============================================================================
# short_volume_ratio is PERCENTAGE (0-100), NOT decimal (0-1).
# Threshold of 50% = 50.0, not 0.50.

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

sv = short_volume()()
ratio = sv.short_volume_ratio

# === CORRECT: threshold in percentage units ===
high_short = ratio > 50.0    # 50% = heavy shorting
low_short = ratio < 30.0     # 30% = light shorting

# === WRONG: decimal threshold would NEVER fire ===
# wrong_high = ratio > 0.50  # This would match 0.5% — virtually never true

# === REPORTERS ===
histogram(
    title="Short Volume Ratio Distribution (0-100 scale)",
    category="Units",
    bins=30
)(ratio)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="SV Ratio", dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="High Short Volume (>50%)"
    )
)(ratio, high_short)
